name: Hannah Buckingham
bio: I am an interdisciplinary artist and facilitator, based in Portsmouth, working with queer histories and communities and engaging in intimate investigations of place, drawing from archives and local heritage. My work explores how identity and belonging are embodied in our environment and the senses, neuroqueering themes of transformation, desire and connection. Quietly threading powerful narratives through fiction and fabulation, with a sensitive use of materials. Projects emerge as ever-expanding worlds from an intense period of gathering, exploration, and play, including ‘to make a bed of silt’ and ‘wandering sailor’.
